notes: A stage is drawing only: its size and walls come from data/system/battle.json, so every stage plays the same. Layers are drawn back to front. parallax: 0 = fixed to the screen (sky), 1 = moves with the floor. Heights are in pixels above the ground line. stars: faint twinkling points in the top "band" (0 to 1) of the sky. torches: braziers every "spacing" px on posts "height" px tall; "radius" is how far their light reaches. motes: drifting specks ("drift" px a frame sideways, "rise" upward) in the bottom "band" of the screen. vignette: darkens the edges of the screen behind the fighters ("alpha" 0 = off). floor "sheen": the sun's light lying on the stone. To remove any of these, delete its layer.
